title: Project configuration
subtitle: Manage the project’s participants, groups, vehicles and options.

participants.title: Participants
participants.description: Registered people, guests and individual data

disable.title: Hide the project
disable.description: While the project is hidden, no profile, check-in/check-out or participant can be created in it. You can unhide it at any time.

enable.title: Show the project again
enable.description: The project is currently hidden. Making it visible allows creating profiles, check-ins/check-outs, participants, etc. in it again.

delete.title: Delete the project
delete.description: Permanently deletes the project along with all the items linked to it (profiles, check-ins/check-outs, participants, etc.). This action is irreversible.
